description: This file defines API endpoints related to task management within a project management system, using FastAPI. It includes routes for creating tasks, listing tasks by board with filters, retrieving tasks by ID, and updating task status. It interacts with a database via SQLModel and depends on external modules for database sessions and schemas.

classes.name: StatusUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating the status of a task.

methods.name: TaskRead create_task_endpoint( payload: TaskCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint for creating a new task, linked to a board and optionally a sprint.

methods.name: List[TaskRead] list_tasks_endpoint( board_id: int, status_filter: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by status"), assignee_id: Optional[int] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by assignee"), limit: int = Query(100, ge=1, le=500), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint for listing tasks associated with a specific board, supporting filtering by status and assignee.

methods.name: TaskRead get_task_endpoint( task_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint for retrieving a task by its ID.

methods.name: TaskRead update_task_status_endpoint( task_id: int, update: StatusUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint for updating the status of a specific task.
